title: Arriving in Minneapolis, November 1926
summary: The group reaches Minneapolis for a dance on 1 November, lives in a rented house, rehearses and earns ten dollars for the first job.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: and that Sunday we left and got the whole group that was going to Minneapolis... We all went to Minneapolis. We had this band, see? His father already had booked a dance up there in Minneapolis on the first day of November -- I'll never forget it. I went in the dance hall to play the dance, and never saw the ground no more til June. You know, that's the way it snowed up there at that time. I guess it still do. So we went in and played the dance and came out, and everything was happening(?) and everything was lovely, and he had a nice place. He already had this house rented up there -- some people who was on one of his shows before, he knew them, and they was taking care of the house. All of us stayed in one room -- of course, that was all right. Three guys -- me, Prez and Pete.

So we had a good time. Plenty of good food to eat. We rehearsed. Wasn't working. Didn't have no jobs right then, after that job. It was pretty good money; we made ten dollars, which was a lot of money then! Made ten dollars for that night. At that time, I didn't do nothin' but eat. I didn't smoke, didn't drink, didn't do nothin'. You know what I mean? I was straight life. We made it good.
